mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.5% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for the trigger condition is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand and business investment, which together predict negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: The joint decline of HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of cases, or the Rank IC for the interaction term is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of industrial production slowdown (INDPRO growth rate below 0.5% annually), manufacturing weakness signals reduced corporate capacity utilization and lower earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO growth is below 0.5% annually, or the Rank IC for the regime condition is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 3.0%, it signals persistent price pressures that prompt central bank tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%, or the Rank IC for the trigger condition is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate revenue, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of periods with PAYEMS growth, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During late-cycle economic expansions (as measured by GDPC1 growth above 2.5% annually), the risk of overheating and policy tightening increases, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth is above 2.5% annually, or the Rank IC for the regime condition is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1.2 million units annually, it signals a contraction in the housing sector that reduces construction activity and consumer confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when HOUST < 1.2 million, or the Rank IC for the trigger condition is below 0.03.
